mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password, handle, nickname, phone) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{handle}, #{nickname}, #{phone} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.handle, u.profile_image as profileImage, u.bio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE target_user_id = u.id) as followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE user_id = u.id) as followingCount, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as isFollowing, CASE WHEN f_me.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as isFollower FROM users u LEFT JOIN follows f ON f.target_user_id = u.id AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId} LEFT JOIN follows f_me ON f_me.user_id = u.id AND f_me.target_user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.handle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
